title: Ghosts of the Past
description: The Claimants scavenge through ruined cities, searching for salvage to fuel their rebellion. But in these same ruins, the Wardens return to reclaim their ancient artifacts. What begins as a chance encounter soon becomes a desperate contest over relics of power.

missions.title: Scavengers and Sentinels
missions.description: The Claimants fan out across the ruins, searching for valuable caches. But the Wardens are already here, reclaiming what is theirs. The first clash will decide who controls the treasures hidden in the rubble.
missions.setup: Place 3 Cache Markers: one in the center of the West, Center, and East tiles.
missions.deployment: Each Squad deploys from opposite Battlefield edges before Turn 1.
missions.special:
**Mission Action: Claim (2ACT)**  
A Unit Adjacent to a Cache may spend 2ACT to secure it for their side. Once Claimed, place a marker indicating its ownership. A Claimed marker may be reclaimed by the opposing Squad.
A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemy Units, or if the Cache is Adjacent to any enemy Units.
missions.victory:
- The Outer Claim wins if they own at least 2 Caches by the end of Turn 4. **Proceed to Mission 2A**
- The Relict Wardens win in all other cases. **Proceed to Mission 2B**

missions.title: Deny the Relics
missions.description: With caches secured, the Claimants must prevent the Wardens from retaking them. They know the relics are dangerous and they will destroy them if they must.
missions.setup: Claimant Warband secretly marks three Units to be Relic Carriers. These Units carry one Relic each. If a Relic Carrier reaches zero `HIT`, it drops the Relic.
missions.deployment:
- Outer Claim deploy from the Southern battlefield edge before Turn 1.
- Relict Wardens deploy from the Northern battlefield edge before Turn 1.
missions.victory:
- The Outer Claim wins if its Units are still carrying at least 2 Relics by the end of Turn 4. **Proceed to Mission 3A**
- The Relict Wardens win in all other cases. **Proceed to Mission 3B**

missions.title: Reclaim the Caches
missions.description: The Wardens drive back the scavengers, sweeping the ruins to recover their relics. The Claimants fight to keep their prize or deny it to all.
missions.setup: Relict Wardens secretly marks three Units to be Relic Carriers. These Units carry one Relic each. If a Relic Carrier reaches less than half of its `HIT`, it drops the Relic and it cannot be picked up again.
missions.deployment:
- Relict Wardens deploy from the Southern battlefield edge before Turn 1.
- Outer Claim deploy from the Northern battlefield edge before Turn 1.
missions.victory:
- The Relict Wardens win if their Units are still carrying at least 2 Relics by the end of Turn 4. **Proceed to Mission 3A**
- The Outer Claim win in all other cases. **Proceed to Mission 3B**

missions.title: Burn the Past
missions.description: The Claimants resolve to erase what cannot be claimed. Fires spread through the ruins as they attempt to burn every last relic before the Wardens can stop them.
missions.setup:
Outer Claim secretly marks 3 Units as Relic Carriers.

Place one Cursed Pit marker in the center of the Central tile.
missions.deployment:
- Relict Wardens deploy from the Southern battlefield edge before Turn 1.
- Outer Claim deploy from the Northern battlefield edge before Turn 1.
missions.special:
**Mission Action: Destroy (2ACT)**  
An Outer Claim Relic Carrier Adjacent to the Cursed Pit may spend 2ACT to Ignite it. At the end of each Turn, roll 1D6 for each Ignited Relic: on 3+, that Relic is destroyed.
A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemy Units.
missions.victory:
- The Outer Claim wins if all 3 Relics are destroyed by the end of Turn 4.
- The Relict Wardens win in all other cases.

missions.title: Sanctify the Relics
missions.description: The Wardens gather their recovered relics to sanctify them in ancient rites, ensuring the Claimants can never threaten them again. The Claimants launch one last desperate assault to disrupt the ceremony.
missions.setup: Place 3 Altar Markers: one in the center of the West, Center, and East tiles. Place a Relic atop each Altar.
missions.deployment:
- Relict Wardens deploy within 2 Squares of any Altar before Turn 1.
- Outer Claim deploy from the Southern battlefield edge before Turn 1.
missions.special:
**Mission Action: Sanctify (2ACT)**  
Relict Warden Units may attempt to Sanctify (2ACT) a relic while Adjacent to an Altar. Place a Sanctify marker on that Relic. At the end of each Turn, roll 1D6 for each of the Sanctified Relics: On a 1 or 2, that Relic is successfully Sanctified.
A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemy Units, or if the Altar is Adjacent to any enemy Units.
missions.victory:
- The Relict Wardens win if all 3 Relics are successfully Sanctified by the end of Turn 4.
- The Outer Claim wins in all other cases.

title: Broken Chains
description: The Silent Choir seeks to enthrall the leaders of the Claimants, binding them in chains of whispered compulsions. The Claimants rally to break this grip before their rebellion is shattered from within. Each battle swings between domination and freedom, until only one side remains in control of the Claimants' destiny.

missions.title: The Ensnared Leaders
missions.description: The Choir has already begun its work, dragging Outer Claim leaders toward ritual chambers. The Claimants must intercept and rescue them before they are lost forever.
missions.setup:
Place 3 Leader Tokens in the center of the Central Tile.
Designate the Eastern battlefield edge as the **Choir Temple Edge** and the Western battlefield edge as the **Claimant Safe Edge**.
missions.deployment:
* Silent Choir deploy from the Eastern battlefield edge before Turn 1.
* Outer Claim deploy from the Western battlefield edge before Turn 1.
missions.special:
**Mission Action: Compel (2ACT)**  
A Silent Choir Unit Adjacent to a Leader Token may spend 2ACT to move it 2 Squares toward the Temple Edge.
A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemy Units.

**Mission Action: Rescue (2ACT)**  
An Outer Claim Unit Adjacent to a Leader Token may spend 2ACT to move it 2 Squares toward the Safe Edge.
A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemy Units, or if the Leader Token is Adjacent to any enemy Units.

Leader Tokens cannot be destroyed and may not be carried.
missions.victory:
* The Silent Choir wins if at least 2 Leader Tokens are within 2 Squares of the Temple Edge before the end of Turn 4. **Proceed to Mission 2B**
* The Outer Claim wins if at least 2 Leader Tokens are within 2 Squares of the Safe Edge before the end of Turn 4. **Proceed to Mission 2A**
* If neither side achieves this, the side with more Tokens closer to their edge wins.

missions.title: Purge the Shrines
missions.description: The Claimants press into the Choir's sanctum, where a great shrine pulses with malign power. The ritual is already underway; the Choir seeks to complete its corruption, while the Claimants fight to cleanse it.
missions.setup:
Place 1 Central Shrine Marker in the center of the Central Tile.
Place 4 Ritual Counters on the Shrine.
missions.deployment:
* Silent Choir deploy within 2 Squares of the Shrine before Turn 1.
* Outer Claim deploy from the Southern battlefield edge before Turn 1.
missions.special:
**Corrupt Shrine (2ACT)**  
During Turns 1-2, the Silent Choir may perform this Action while Adjacent to the Shrine. Each success adds 1 Ritual Counter (max 6).
A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemy Units, or if the Shrine is Adjacent to any enemy Units.

**Cleanse Shrine (2ACT)**  
During Turns 3-4, the Outer Claim may perform this Action while Adjacent to the Shrine. Each success removes 1 Ritual Counter (min 0).
A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemy Units, or if the Shrine is Adjacent to any enemy Units.
missions.victory:
* The Silent Choir wins if the Shrine has 4 or more Ritual Counters at the end of Turn 4. **Proceed to Mission 3B**
* The Outer Claim wins if the Shrine has 2 or fewer Ritual Counters at the end of Turn 4. **Proceed to Mission 3A**
* If the Shrine has exactly 3 Counters, play 1 extra Turn; at the end, whichever side moved it furthest in their direction is the winner.

missions.title: The Spreading Blight
missions.description: With Claimant leaders enthralled, the Choir's corruption seeps into the wilds. Idols are raised, radiating their influence across the land. The Claimants must shatter them before the rot spreads too far.
missions.setup: Place 2 Idol Markers: one in the center of the Northwest Tile, one in the center of the Northeast Tile.
missions.deployment:
* Silent Choir deploy within 3 Squares of any Idol before Turn 1.
* Outer Claim deploy from the Southern battlefield edge before Turn 1.
missions.special:
**Blight Aura**: At the start of each Turn, all Units within 3 Squares of an Idol must roll 1D6. On a 5–6, they lose 1ACT this Turn.

**Mission Action: Shatter Idol (2ACT)**  
A Unit Adjacent to an Idol may spend 2ACT to destroy it.
A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemy Units, or if the Idol is Adjacent to any enemy Units.
missions.victory:
* The Silent Choir wins if at least 1 Idol remains standing at the end of Turn 4. **Proceed to Mission 3B**
* The Outer Claim wins if both Idols are destroyed by the end of Turn 4. **Proceed to Mission 3A**

missions.title: Chains Broken
missions.description: The Claimants surge through the ruins, desperate to free their kin. The Choir holds captives for the final ritual, but the rebels will not rest until their leaders are safe.
missions.setup: Place 3 Captive Markers: one in the center of each of the Northwest, North, and Northeast tiles.
missions.deployment:
* Silent Choir deploy within 2 Squares of any Captive before Turn 1.
* Outer Claim deploy from the Southern battlefield edge before Turn 1.
missions.special:
**Mission Action: Free (2ACT)**  
An Outer Claim Unit Adjacent to a Captive may spend 2ACT to Free them. Place a Freed marker on the Captive.
A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemy Units, or if the Captive is Adjacent to any enemy Units.
missions.victory:
* The Outer Claim wins if at least 2 Captives are Freed by the end of Turn 4.
* The Silent Choir wins in all other cases.

missions.title: Shackled Rebellion
missions.description: The Choir's enthralled leaders are brought to the cursed temple for the final compulsion. If the ritual completes, the rebellion will be theirs to command. The Claimants launch a last, desperate attack to shatter the ritual chains.
missions.setup: Place 1 Ritual Track (off-board) starting at 0.
missions.deployment:
* Silent Choir deploy within 2 Squares of the Central Tile before Turn 1.
* Outer Claim deploy from the Southern battlefield edge before Turn 1.
missions.special:
**Mission Action: Compel (2ACT)**  
Once per Turn, a Silent Choir Unit Adjacent to the Central Altar may spend 2ACT to advance the Ritual Track by 1. Max 6.
A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemy Units, or if the Altar is Adjacent to any enemy Units.

**Mission Action: Disrupt (2ACT)**  
Once per Turn, an Outer Claim Unit Adjacent to the Central Altar may spend 2ACT to reduce the Ritual Track by 1. Min 0.
A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemy Units, or if the Altar is Adjacent to any enemy Units.
missions.victory:
* The Silent Choir wins if the Ritual Track is 4 or higher at the end of Turn 4.
* The Outer Claim wins if the Ritual Track is 2 or lower at the end of Turn 4.
* If the Ritual Track is exactly 3, play 1 extra Turn; whichever side shifts it further in their direction is the winner.

title: Brood War
description: Rival hive broods clash, each seeking to establish dominance. Strategic ground is seized for spawning, brood chambers are razed, and the conflict culminates in a primal battle between the Brood Mothers themselves. Only one strain will survive to spread its genes across the stars.

missions.title: Seeds of Domination
missions.description: The rival broods race to seize ground outside the hive, places to twist and transform into new spawning sites. The stronger swarm will claim this ground, setting the stage for the battles to come.
missions.setup: Place 3 Strategic Point Markers: one in the center of the West, Center, and East tiles.
missions.deployment: Each Squad deploys from opposite battlefield edges before Turn 1.
missions.special:
**Mission Action: Infest (2ACT)**  
A Unit Adjacent to a Strategic Point may spend 2ACT to Infest it. Place a marker showing its control.
missions.victory: - A Squad wins if they control at least 2 Strategic Points at the end of Turn 4. **Proceed to Mission 2**

missions.title: Raze the Brood
missions.description: With ground secured, the victorious swarm seeded its spawning pools. The defeated Squad targets their brood chambers, the lifeblood of the enemy strain. If the brood is destroyed, the rival will wither.
missions.setup: Place 3 Spawn Point Markers: one in the center of the West, Center, and East tiles.
missions.deployment:
- The Squad that won Mission 1 deploys within 2 Squares of any Spawn Point. This is the defending Squad.
- The Squad that lost Mission 1 deploys from the Northern battlefield edge. This is the attacking Squad.
missions.special: Spawn Points are treated as items with `ARM` **4** and `HIT` **3**. They may be targeted in Combat.
missions.victory:
- The attacking Squad wins if they destroy at least 2 Spawn Points by the end of Turn 4. **Proceed to Mission 3**
- The defending Squad wins in all other cases. **Proceed to Mission 3**

missions.title: Last Brood Standing
missions.description: The defending swarm holds what's left of its brood chambers. The rivals crash together one final time, their leaders circling in the carnage until only one remains alive to claim dominance.
missions.setup: Place 1 Brood Core Marker in the center of the Central Tile.
missions.deployment:
- The Squad that won Mission 2 deploys within 2 Squares of the Brood Core. This is the defending Squad.
- The Squad that lost Mission 2 deploys from the Northern battlefield edge. This is the attacking Squad.
missions.special:
- Only squad leaders may target each other in Combat.
- Other Units may not target enemy leaders.
- Leaders may freely target enemy non-leaders as normal.
- While Adjacent to the Brood Core, defending Units gain **+1** `ATT`.
missions.victory: - The winner is the Squad that first Takes Out the enemy leader.

title: Terror Attack
description: A Claimant Warband plots a devastating terror strike, assembling explosives and preparing to unleash them upon the Hegemony. The Interdictors must intercept, contain, and dismantle the threat before the rebellion's strike shakes the sector.

missions.title: Stolen Charges
missions.description: The Claimants raid supply stores, gathering explosives for their plot. The Interdictors rush to intercept before the caches can be stolen away.
missions.setup: Place 3 Explosive Cache Markers: one in the center of the West, Center, and East tiles.
missions.deployment: Each Squad deploys from opposite battlefield edges before Turn 1.
missions.special:
**Mission Action: Seize Explosives (2ACT)**  
An Outer Claim Unit Adjacent to a Cache may spend 2ACT to claim it. Place a Claimed marker on the Cache.
A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemy Units.

**Mission Action: Secure Explosives (2ACT)**  
An Interdictor Unit Adjacent to a Cache may spend 2ACT to Secure it, removing it from play.
A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemy Units.
missions.victory:
* The Outer Claim wins if they control at least 2 Explosives Caches at the end of Turn 4. **Proceed to Mission 2A**
* The Interdictors win in all other cases. **Proceed to Mission 2B**

missions.title: Assemble the Bomb
missions.description: With explosives secured, the Claimants begin assembling their device. The Interdictors strike hard, desperate to dismantle it before it can be completed.
missions.setup: Place 1 Bomb Marker in the center of the Central Tile.
missions.deployment:
* Outer Claim deploy within 2 Squares of the Bomb before Turn 1.
* Interdictors deploy from the Southern battlefield edge before Turn 1.
missions.special:
**Mission Action: Assemble (2ACT)**  
An Outer Claim Unit Adjacent to the Bomb may spend 2ACT to add 1 Assembly Counter (max 6).
A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemy Units.

**Mission Action: Dismantle (2ACT)**  
An Interdictor Unit Adjacent to the Bomb may spend 2ACT to remove 1 Assembly Counter (min 0).
A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemy Units.
missions.victory:
* The Outer Claim wins if the Bomb has 4 or more Assembly Counters by the end of Turn 4. **Proceed to Mission 3A**
* The Interdictors win in all other cases. **Proceed to Mission 3B**

missions.title: Hidden Stockpiles
missions.description: The Interdictors have denied the initial raid, but the Claimants maintain hidden stockpiles in the wilds. If they recover them, the plan may yet succeed.
missions.setup: Place 2 Stockpile Markers: one in the center of the Northwest Tile, one in the center of the Northeast Tile.
missions.deployment:
* Outer Claim deploy within 2 Squares of any Stockpile before Turn 1.
* Interdictors deploy from the Southern battlefield edge before Turn 1.
missions.special:
**Mission Action: Destroy Stockpile (2ACT)**  
An Interdictor Unit Adjacent to a Stockpile may spend 2ACT to destroy it. Remove it from play.
A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemy Units, or if the Stockpile is Adjacent to any enemy Units.
missions.victory:
* The Outer Claim wins if at least 1 Stockpile is Claimed by the end of Turn 4. **Proceed to Mission 3A**
* The Interdictors win if both Stockpiles are destroyed. **Proceed to Mission 3B**

missions.title: Detonate the Device
missions.description: The bomb is ready, and the Claimants push to plant and detonate it. The Interdictors' only hope is to defuse the device before it can be unleashed.
missions.setup: Place 1 Bomb Marker in the center of the Central Tile.
missions.deployment:
* Outer Claim deploy from the Northern battlefield edge before Turn 1.
* Interdictors deploy from the Southern battlefield edge before Turn 1.
missions.special:
**Mission Action: Plant Bomb (2ACT)**  
An Outer Claim Unit Adjacent to the Bomb may spend 2ACT to Arm it. Place an Armed marker on the Bomb.
A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemy Units.

**Mission Action: Defuse (2ACT)**  
An Interdictor Unit Adjacent to an Armed Bomb may spend 2ACT to remove the Armed marker.
A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemy Units.
missions.victory:
* The Outer Claim wins if the Bomb is Armed at the end of Turn 4.
* The Interdictors win in all other cases.

missions.title: Contain the Blast
missions.description: The Claimants' terror strike is incomplete, but dangerous charges remain. The Interdictors work to secure and contain them, while the Claimants attempt to trigger whatever destruction they still can.
missions.setup: Place 3 Charge Markers: one in the center of the West, Center, and East tiles.
missions.deployment:
* Outer Claim deploy within 2 Squares of any Charge before Turn 1.
* Interdictors deploy from the Southern battlefield edge before Turn 1.
missions.special:
**Mission Action: Arm (2ACT)**  
An Outer Claim Unit Adjacent to a Charge may spend 2ACT to arm it.
A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemy Units.

**Mission Action: Disarm (2ACT)**  
An Interdictor Unit Adjacent to an Armed Charge may spend 2ACT to Disarm it.
A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemy Units.
missions.victory:
* The Outer Claim wins if both Charges are armed at the end of Turn 4.
* The Interdictors win in all other cases.

title: Infestation
description: The Hegemony seeks to root out the Swarm infestation, while the Swarm fights for survival and dominance.

missions.title: Breach and Infiltrate
missions.description: The facility's lower levels are sealed. The Interdictors must breach the perimeter to gain access, while the Swarm defends the hatch and denies entry.
missions.setup: Place a Hatch marker in the center square of the central tile.
missions.deployment:
Interdictors deploy before Turn 1 on any battlefield edge.
The Swarm deploys before Turn 1 within 3 squares of the Hatch marker.
missions.special:
The Hatch is an item with `ARM` **4** and `HIT` **4** and may be targeted in Combat.
If the Hatch reaches 0 HIT, it is breached.

**Mission Action: Torch Breach (2ACT)**  
Once per Turn, a Unit Adjacent to the Hatch may spend 2ACT to remove 1 `HIT` from it.
A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemy Units.
missions.victory:
- The Interdictors win the Mission if the Hatch is breached before the end of Turn 4. **Proceed to Mission 2A**
- The Swarm wins in all other cases. **Proceed to Mission 2B**

missions.title: Destroy the Nests
missions.description: Within the facility, three nests sustain the infestation. The Interdictors aim to destroy them to cripple the Swarm, while the Swarm must hold at all costs.
missions.setup: Deploy 3 Spawn Points, one in the center of the West, Center, and East Tiles.
missions.deployment:
Each Squad selects one of two opposing Battlefield edges to be their Deployment zone.
Both Squads deploy from their Battlefield edge before Turn 1.
missions.special:
Spawn Points are treated as items with `ARM` **4** and `HIT` **2**.
Spawn Points cannot be targeted in Ranged combat if there is at least one Swarm Unit Adjacent to that Spawn Point.
If a Spawn Point is targeted in combat and is not Taken Out as a result of that combat, it regains all of its `HIT`.
missions.victory:
- Interdictors win the Mission if all three Spawn Points are destroyed before the end of Turn 4. **Proceed to Mission 3A**
- Swarm wins the Mission in all other cases. **Proceed to Mission 3B**

missions.title: Another Way
missions.description: With the direct route blocked, an alternate path must be secured. A control room holds the means to open access, but activation takes time and the defenders will not yield it willingly.
missions.setup: Place one Console in the center of each of the Northwest, North, and Northeast tiles.
missions.deployment:
The Swarm deploys its Units within 2 Squares of a Console before Turn 1.
Interdictors deploy from the southern edge of the Battlefield before Turn 1.
missions.special:
**Mission Action: Activate Console (2ACT)**  
One Unit Adjacent to a Console may spend 2ACT to Activate that Console.
A Unit may not perform this action if it is Adjacent to any enemy Units.
missions.victory:
- Interdictors win the Mission if all three Consoles are activated before the end of Turn 4. **Proceed to Mission 2A**
- Swarm wins in all other cases. **Proceed to Mission 3B**

missions.title: Purge The Infestation
missions.description: With the facility's defenses collapsing, the Interdictors must eradicate the remnants of the Swarm while the Swarm must rally for survival.
missions.deployment:
The Swarm deploys anywhere on the Battlefield before Turn 1.
Interdictors deploy from the southern edge of the Battlefield before Turn 1.
missions.victory:
- The Interdictors win the Mission if all enemy Units have been Taken Out by the end of Turn 4.
- The Swarm wins the Mission if at least one Unit remains Standing by the end of Turn 4.

missions.title: Hold Until Evac
missions.description: The Interdictors operation has failed. They must hold out long enough for extraction, while the Swarm surge from every direction to overwhelm them.
missions.setup: Set up terrain so that the central tile is at least half enclosed.
missions.deployment:
Interdictors deploy all Units anywhere on the Central Tile.
During Turn 1, when it is a Swarm Unit's Activation, deploy it on any Battlefield edge.
missions.special: Drone Pod always has the Initative in Turn 1.
missions.victory:
At the end of Turn 4, each Squad adds up the remaining HIT of Standing Units on the central tile.
The Squad with the highest total wins the Mission.
In case of a tie, the Swarm wins the Mission.

title: Splinter Group
description: Accusations of heresy and corruption splinter the ranks, and brother turns against brother. Each side believes itself the true loyalists, but only one squad will emerge to carry the banner forward.

missions.title: The Hidden Trail
missions.description: The Loyalists pursue fragments of intelligence in the wilds, seeking the location of the Splinter Group's secret headquarters.
missions.setup: Place 1 Intel marker in the center of the central Tile.
missions.deployment: Each Squad deploys from opposite Battlefield edges before Turn 1.
missions.special: Loyalists may pick up the Intel marker. If a Unit carrying the Intel marker is Taken Out, the marker is dropped in that Unit's Square.
missions.victory:
- The Loyalists win if they are carrying the Intel Marker by the end of Turn 4. **Proceed to Mission 2A**
- The Splinter Group wins in all other cases. **Proceed to Mission 2B**

missions.title: Infiltrate the Headquarters
missions.description: The Loyalists strike at the Splinter Group's hidden fortress. Its gates are locked, its defenses prepared, but the Loyalists mean to breach the walls and expose the traitors within.
missions.setup:
Place 1 Gate Marker in the center of the Eastern edge of the Central Tile.

All Squares North and South of the Gate are considered an impassable wall. Units may shoot through those Squares, but may not move through them.

All Squares East of the Gate are considered to be Ramparts: Units on those Squares should be considered to be 2 Squares above the western part of the battlefield and have High Ground (no cover when targeting enemies lower than them).
missions.deployment:
- Splinter Group deploys anywhere East of the Gate before Turn 1.
- Loyalists deploy from the Western battlefield edge before Turn 1.
missions.special:
The Gate has `ARM` **4** and `HIT` **6**. It may be targeted in Combat.

**Mission Action: Override Gate (2ACT)**  
Once per Turn, a Loyalist Unit Adjacent to the Gate may spend 2ACT to reduce its `HIT` by 1.
A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemy Units.
missions.victory:
- The Loyalists win if the Gate is destroyed (reduced to 0 HIT) before the end of Turn 4. **Proceed to Mission 3A**
- The Splinter Group wins in all other cases. **Proceed to Mission 3B**

missions.title: The Informant
missions.description: The Splinter Group moves to silence a captured informant before they can betray their plans. The Loyalists race to extract them, for within lies the key to where the traitors will strike next, and where to find them and stop them.
missions.setup: Place 1 Informant Marker in the center of the Central Tile.
missions.deployment:
- Splinter Group deploys within 2 Squares of the Informant Marker before Turn 1.
- Loyalists deploy from the Southern battlefield edge before Turn 1.
missions.special:
The Informant cannot be targeted, attacked, or destroyed; both sides require them alive.

**Mission Action: Secure Informant (2ACT)**  
A Loyalist Unit Adjacent to the Informant may spend 2ACT to Secure them. Place a Secured marker on the Informant.
A Unit may not perform this action if it is Adjacent to any enemies, or if the Informant is Adjacent to any Splinter Group Units.

At the end of the game, if the Informant is Secured and at least one Loyalist Unit is Standing within 2 Squares of the Informant, the Loyalists hold the Informant.
missions.victory:
- The Loyalists win if they hold the Informant at the end of Turn 4. **Proceed to Mission 3**
- The Splinter Group wins in all other cases. **Proceed to Mission 3**

missions.title: Rivals
missions.description: The feud reaches its climax. The leaders of each faction have sworn a blood oath: only one will remain standing. Squads clash around them, but the duel of commanders will decide the future of the Interdictors.
missions.deployment: Each Squad deploys from opposite battlefield edges before Turn 1.
missions.special:
- Only squad leaders may target each other in Combat
- Other Units may not target enemy leaders
- Leaders may freely target enemy non-leaders as normal
missions.victory: - The winner is the squad that first Takes Out the opposing Leader.

title: Power Grab
description: The Grutak raid deep into Hegemony territory, hungry for loot, dominance, and the thrill of proving who's strongest. The Interdictors scramble to protect convoys, sabotage raids, and break the mob before it grows out of control.

missions.title: Loot the Convoy
missions.description: The Interdictors' convoy rumbles across the battlefield, laden with weapons and ordnance. The Krumpfists swarm to board and loot it, even as its armored bulk crushes everything in its path.
missions.setup:
The Convoy is represented by a large marker that covers 3x3 Squares and is 1 Square tall.
It begins off-board.
At the start of Turns 2, place the Convoy covering the central 3×3 Squares of the Western Tile. Inflict 3 Melee Damage on any Units that are directly West of it.
The Convoy is unaffected by any battlefield events or effects.
missions.deployment:
* Interdictors deploy from the Western edge of the Northwest and Southwest tiles before Turn 1.
* Krumpfists deploy from the Northern and Southern battlefield edges before Turn 1.
missions.special:
**Convoy Movement:**
At the start of each Turn after the first, each Unit that is on the Convoy moves one Square to the West. Then, move the Convoy (and the Units that are still standing on it) 1 Tile East.
Any Units between its previous and new position are "run over", taking 3 Melee Damage.

**Mission Action: Loot Convoy (2ACT)**  
A Krumpfist Unit standing on the Convoy may spend 2ACT to loot it.
A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to enemy Units.
missions.victory:
* The Krumpfists win if they perform at least 2 Loot Convoy Actions by the end of Turn 4. **Proceed to Mission 2A**
* The Interdictors win in all other cases. **Proceed to Mission 2B**

missions.title: Smash the Depot
missions.description: Emboldened by their raid, the Krumpfists storm an Interdictor strongpoint. Inside are the depots where the Hegemony stores its supplies. If the Krumpfists can smash enough of them, the victory will be theirs.
missions.setup: Place 3 Depot Markers: one in the center of each of the Northwest, North, and Northeast tiles.
missions.deployment:
* Interdictors deploy within 2 Squares of any Depot before Turn 1.
* Krumpfists deploy from the Southern battlefield edge before Turn 1.
missions.special:
Depots are items with `ARM` **4** and `HIT` **3**. They may be targeted in Combat.

**Mission Action: Sabotage Depot (2ACT)**  
A Krumpfist Unit Adjacent to a Depot may spend 2ACT to remove 1 `HIT` from it.
A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemy Units, or if the Depot is Adjacent to any Interdictors.
missions.victory:
* INterdcitors win if at least 2 Depots have not been destroyed by the end of Turn 4. **Proceed to Mission 3A**
* Krumpfists win in all other cases. **Proceed to Mission 3B**

missions.title: Hold the Line
missions.description: The Interdictors repulsed the first assault and fall back to hold a fortified line. The Krumpfists see weakness and rush to smash their defenses before their enemy can regroup.
missions.setup: Place 3 Strongpoint Markers in the center of the West, Center, and East tiles.
missions.deployment:
* Interdictors deploy within 2 Squares of any Strongpoint before Turn 1.
* Krumpfists deploy from the Northern or Southern battlefield edge before Turn 1.
missions.special:
Strongpoints are items with `ARM` **4** and `HIT` **4**. They may be targeted in Combat.

**Mission Action: Fortify (2ACT)**  
Once per Turn, an Interdictor Unit Adjacent to a Strongpoint may spend 2ACT to restore 1 lost `HIT` on it.
A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemy Units.

**Mission Action: Smash (2ACT)**  
Once per Turn, a Krumpfists Unit Adjacent to a Strongpoint may spend 2ACT to smash it and remove 1 `HIT` from it.
A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemy Units.

At the end of the game, any Strongpoint with at least 2 `HIT` remaining is considered Held.
missions.victory:
* The Interdictors win if at least 2 Strongpoints are Held at the end of Turn 4. **Proceed to Mission 3A**
* The Krumpfists win in all other cases. **Proceed to Mission 3B**

missions.title: Grudge Krump
missions.description: The Interdictors' victories have eroded the Krumpfists Leader's influence and authority. To prove itself to its Squad and quell a mutiny, it swears a Grudge Krump to defeat the Interdictors' leader.
missions.deployment: - Each Squad deploys from one of two opposing battlefield edges before Turn 1.
missions.special:
* Only squad leaders may target each other in Combat.
* Other Units may not target enemy leaders.
* Leaders may freely target enemy non-leaders as normal.
missions.victory: * The winner is the Squad whose leader survives while the opposing leader is Taken Out.

missions.title: The Last Bastion
missions.description: Flush with victory, the Krumpfists launch one last push against the Interdictors' bastion. The Hegemony must hold here or risk losing control of the entire sector.
missions.setup: Place 1 Bastion Marker in the center of the Central Tile.
missions.deployment:
* Interdictors deploy within 2 Squares of the Bastion before Turn 1.
* Krumpfists deploy from the Northern and Southern battlefield edges before Turn 1.
missions.special:
The Bastion has `ARM` **3** and `HIT` **6**. It may be targeted in Combat.

**Mission Action: Reinforce Bastion (2ACT)**  
Once per Turn, an Interdictor Unit Adjacent to the Bastion may spend 2ACT to restore 1 `HIT` to it.
A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemy Units.
missions.victory:
* The Krumpfists win if the Bastion is destroyed (0 HIT) by the end of Turn 4.
* The Interdictors win in all other cases.

title: Dark Ritual
description: Centered around an ancient artifact and a blasphemous summoning ritual. The Interdictors seek to deny the Choir at every turn, while the Choir strives to complete their rite no matter the cost.

missions.title: The Search
missions.description: Whispers of the artifact echo through the broken streets. The Silent Choir scours the ruins for the relic, while the Interdictors close in to halt the search. The one who holds the artifact controls the path to what comes next.
missions.setup: Place 1 Search Marker in the center of each of the West, Central, and East tiles.
missions.deployment: Each Squad deploys from opposite Battlefield edges before Turn 1.
missions.special:
**Mission Action: Search (2ACT)**  
A Silent Choir Unit Adjacent to a Search Marker may spend 2ACT to search it.
Roll 1D6. This roll cannot be modified or re-rolled by using TOs.

- On the first searched marker, the Artifact is found on a roll of 1
- On the second searched marker, the Artifact is found on a roll of 1 or 2
- On the third searched marker, the Artifact is found automatically

After searching a marker, remove it from the Battlefield.
Once found, the Artifact is carried by the Unit that found it.

A Unit may not perform this Action while Adjacent to any enemy Units, or if the Search Marker is Adjacent to any enemy Units.
missions.victory:
- The Silent Choir wins if they are carrying the Artifact at the end of Turn 4. **Proceed to Mission 2A**
- The Interdictors win in all other cases. **Proceed to Mission 2B**

missions.title: Blood Offering
missions.description: The Choir carries the relic into the warzone, aiming to satisfy the ritual's demand for blood. The Interdictors rush to prevent a massacre, but in this dark work even the Choir's own deaths could feed their cause.
missions.deployment: Each Squad selects one of two opposing Battlefield edges as their Deployment Zone. Both deploy before Turn 1.
missions.victory:
- The Silent Choir wins if more than half of all Units (across both Squads combined) are Taken Out by the end of Turn 4. **Proceed to Mission 3A**
- The Interdictors win in all other cases. **Proceed to Mission 3B**

missions.title: Ambush in the Jungle
missions.description: Believing themselves safe with the artifact, the Interdictors vanish into the choking jungle. But the Choir lies in wait among the shadows, ready to strike and wrest the relic from their grasp.
missions.setup: Before deployment, secretly mark one Interdictor Unit as the Artifact Carrier.
missions.deployment:
Before Turn 1, Silent Choir deploys all units anywhere in the Northeast, East, or Southeast Tiles.
During Turn 1, when it is an Interdictor Unit's turn to activate, deploy it on the outer edge of the Western tile. Interdictors always have the initiative in Turn 1.
missions.special: The Artifact may be dropped if the carrier is Taken Out or voluntarily drops it. Another Unit may pick it up by moving Adjacent and spending 1ACT.
missions.victory:
- The Silent Choir wins if they are carrying the Artifact at the end of Turn 4. **Proceed to Mission 2A**
- The Interdictors win in all other cases. **Proceed to Mission 3B**

missions.title: The Summoning
missions.description: With the relic secured and blood spilled, the Choir reaches the cursed temple. At its profane altars they chant to awaken something terrible. The Interdictors charge in, knowing that if they fail here, the galaxy will pay the price.
missions.setup: Place 3 Altar Markers in the central squares of the West, Center, and East tiles.
missions.deployment:
Silent Choir deploys before Turn 1 within 2 Squares of an Altar.
Interdictors deploy before Turn 1 on the Southern Battlefield edge.
missions.special:
A Unit "Controls" an Altar if:

- The Unit is Adjacent to that marker,
- The Unit is not Adjacent to any enemy Units, and
- There are no enemy Units Adjacent to that Altar
missions.victory:
- The Silent Choir wins if they control all 3 Altars by the end of Turn 4.
- The Interdictors win in all other cases.

missions.title: Sabotage the Temple
missions.description: The Choir's summoning has been thwarted, and now the Interdictors launch a final desperate strike. They will tear down the temple itself if they must, ending the ritual in fire and ruin. The Choir will defend their unholy ground with every last breath.
missions.setup: Place 3 Sabotage Markers central squares of the West, Center, and East tiles.
missions.deployment:
Silent Choir deploys anywhere within 3 Squares of a Sabotage marker before Turn 1.
Interdictors deploy from any Battlefield edge before Turn 1.
missions.special:
**Mission Action: Sabotage (2ACT)**  
A Unit Adjacent to a Sabotage Marker may spend 2ACT to sabotage it.
A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemy Units.
missions.victory:
- The Interdictors win if all 3 markers are sabotaged by the end of Turn 4.
- The Silent Choir wins in all other cases.

title: Da Biggest Krump
description: The clans clash in a brutal contest to decide who's boss. Loot piles are smashed, brawls erupt across the field, and the last warband standing will claim the right to lead. There's no subtlety here, just a whole lotta krumpin'.

missions.title: Grab Da Loot
missions.description: The Grutak gather to fight over a massive pile of loot. Whoever claims the most shinies will have the upper hand in the brawl to come.
missions.setup: Place 3 Loot Pile Markers: one in the center of the West, Center, and East tiles.
missions.deployment: Each Squad deploys from opposite battlefield edges before Turn 1.
missions.special:
**Mission Action: Grab Loot (2ACT)**  
A Unit Adjacent to a Loot Pile may spend 2ACT to claim it. The Unit's Squad gains 1MP.
A Unit may not perform this action if it is Adjacent to any enemy Units.
missions.victory: - The Squad with the most MP by the end of Turn 4 wins the mission. In case of a tie, the Squad with the most remaining Standing Units wins the mission. In case of a tie, play one more Turn until a winner is clear. **Proceed to Mission 2**

missions.title: Da Good Fight
missions.description: The winning mob pushes deeper, claiming the best fightin' ground. The rivals meet in the open, ready to prove who hits harder.
missions.deployment: Each Squad deploys from opposite battlefield edges before Turn 1.
missions.victory: The Squad with the most remaining Standing Units at the end of Turn 4 wins the mission. In case of a tie, play one more Turn until a winner is clear. **Proceed to Mission 3**

missions.title: Who'z Da Boss?
missions.description: Each mob raises totems to prove their claim to leadership. But in true Grutak fashion, the best way to prove you're boss is to smash the other mob's totems while keeping your own standing.
missions.setup:
- Place three Totem markers in the center of the Northeast, East, and Southeast tiles. These are Squad A's totems.
- Place three Totem markers in the center of the Northwest, West, and SouthWest tiles. These are Squad B's totems
missions.deployment: - Each Squad deploys their Units within 3 Squares of their Totems before Turn 1.
missions.special:
Totems are items with `ARM` **4** and `HIT` **3**. Totems may be targeted in combat. When a Totem reaches 0 `HIT`, it is destroyed.

**Mission Action: Smash Totem (2ACT)**  
A Unit Adjacent to a Totem may spend 2ACT to remove 1 `HIT` from it.  
A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemy Units, or if the Totem is Adjacent to any enemy Units.
missions.victory: - The Squad that destroyed the most enemy Totems wins the mission. In case of a tie, the Squad with more Standing Units wins. In case of a Tie, play more Turns until a winner is clear.

title: Iron Break
description: The Wardens strive to restore their ancient fortresses, reactivating long-dormant pylons of power. The Krumpfists come crashing in for loot and the thrill of battle, eager to smash stone and bone alike. Only one side will hold the ruins when the dust settles.

missions.title: Breach the Fortress
missions.description: The Wardens labor to restore their fortress, but the Grutak are already at the gates. Krumpfist mobs surge forward, eager to tear down the walls and plunder whatever lies within.
missions.setup:
The Fortress occupies the three Northern tiles (Northeast, North, Northwest).
Place 3 Gate Markers: one centered on the Southern edge of each Northern tile. These Gate markers cannot be traversed by Units until they are destroyed.
missions.deployment:
- Relict Wardens deploy anywhere within the Fortress before Turn 1.
- Krumpfists deploy within 2 Squares of the Southern battlefield edge before Turn 1.
missions.special:
Krumpfists have the initiative in Turn 1.

Each Gate Marker has `ARM` **4** and `HIT` **4**.
Gates may be targeted in Combat and are affected by Ruined City battlefield effects just like any Unit. If reduced to 0 HIT, that Gate is destroyed.

**Mission Action: Break Gate (2ACT)**  
Once per Turn, a Krumpfist Unit Adjacent to a Gate may spend 2ACT to remove 1 HIT from it.
A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemies.
missions.victory:
- The Relict Wardens win if at least 2 of the 3 Gates are still standing by the end of Turn 4. **Proceed to Mission 2A**
- The Krumpfists win in all other cases. **Proceed to Mission 2B**

missions.title: Powering the Pylons
missions.description: The Wardens hold the gates long enough to bring the ancient pylons online. Their energy begins to surge across the battlefield as they are charged. The Grutak must smash them down before they stabilize.
missions.setup: Place 3 Pylon Markers: one in the center of each of the West, Center, and East tiles.
missions.deployment:
- Relict Wardens deploy within 2 Squares of a Pylon before Turn 1.
- Krumpfists deploy from the Western battlefield edge before Turn 1.
missions.special:
**Mission Action: Activate Pylon (2ACT)**  
A Relict Warden Unit Adjacent to a Pylon may spend 2ACT to Activate it.
A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemies, or if the Pylon is Adjacent to any Krumpfists.

Pylons may be targeted in Combat (`ARM` **4**, `HIT` **3**).
missions.victory:
- The Relict Wardens win if at least 2 Pylons are Activated and still Standing by the end of Turn 4. **Proceed to Mission 3A**
- The Krumpfists win in all other cases. **Proceed to Mission 3B**

missions.title: Loot the Works
missions.description: The Krumpfists crash through the gates, scattering the Wardens. Deep within the fortress, they find caches of relic-tech. The plunder is ripe for the taking, unless the Wardens can destroy it first.
missions.setup: Place 3 Cache Markers: one in the center of each of the West, Center, and East tiles.
missions.deployment: Both squads deploy anywhere on the Battlefield before Turn 1, at least 4 Squares away from any Cache Marker.
missions.special:
**Mission Action: Loot (2ACT)**  
Once per Turn, a Krumpfist Unit Adjacent to a Cache may spend 2ACT to Loot it.
A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemies.

**Mission Action: Sabotage (2ACT)**  
Once per Turn, a Relict Warden Unit Adjacent to a Cache may spend 2ACT to Sabotage it.
A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemies.

Once a Cache is either Looted or Sabotaged, remove it from the Battlefield.
missions.victory:
- Krumpfists win if at least 2 of the 3 Caches are Looted by the end of Turn 4. **Proceed to Mission 3A**
- Relict Wardens win in all other cases. **Proceed to Mission 3B**

missions.title: Smash the Pylons
missions.description: With the fortress broken open, the Krumpfists rampage toward the last active pylons. The Wardens must defend them at all costs, or see their works ground into dust once more.
missions.setup: Place 3 Pylon Markers: one in the center of the West, Center, and East tiles.
missions.deployment:
- Relict Wardens deploy within 2 Squares of a Pylon before Turn 1.
- Krumpfists deploy from any Battlefield edge before Turn 1.
missions.special: Pylons are treated as items with `ARM` **4** and `HIT` **4**. They may be targeted in Combat.
missions.victory:
- The Krumpfists win if all 3 Pylons are destroyed by the end of Turn 4.
- The Relict Wardens win in all other cases.

missions.title: The Last Rampart
missions.description: The Wardens rally for one final stand, their fortress heart nearly restored. The Krumpfists must break them here or see the ancient power of the Wardens rise again.
missions.setup: The Central Tile represents the fortress core. Place 1 Core Marker in its center.
missions.deployment:
- Relict Wardens deploy anywhere on the Central Tile before Turn 1.
- Krumpfists deploy from any two opposite battlefield edges before Turn 1.
missions.special:
**Mission Action: Defend (1ACT)**
Once per Turn, a Relict Warden Unit Adjacent to the Core Marker may spend 1ACT to add a Defense Token to it.
A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemies.
missions.victory:
- The Relict Wardens win if the Core has at least 3 Defense Tokens on it, and at least one Relict Warden Unit remains Standing.
- The Krumpfists win in all other cases.

title: Pylons of Power
description: An Interdictors vs Relict Wardens Operation. Beneath the Hegemony's shining city lie the shattered remains of Eidolon pylons: relics of an empire that once wielded world-breaking weapons. The Relict Wardens have returned to reclaim and reactivate these pylons, while the Interdictors fight to prevent catastrophe. What begins as sabotage escalates into horrors in the ruins, and ends with the fate of the pylons decided once and for all.

missions.title: The Forgotten Entrance
missions.description: The Relict Wardens scour the underworks of the Hegemony city, hunting for a hidden entrance into the buried subfoundations where the ancient pylons lie. The Interdictors move to block the search, knowing that if the Wardens find the way in, the city's fate could hang by a thread.
missions.setup: Place 1 Search Marker in the center of each of the West, Central, and East tiles.
missions.deployment: Each Squad deploys from opposite Battlefield edges before Turn 1.
missions.special:
**Mission Action: Search (2ACT)**  
A Relict Wardens Unit Adjacent to a Search Marker may spend 2ACT to search it.  
Roll 1D6. This roll cannot be modified or re-rolled by using TOs.

- On the first searched marker, the Entrance is found on a roll of 1  
- On the second searched marker, the Entrance is found on a roll of 1 or 2  
- On the third searched marker, the Entrance is found automatically  

After searching a marker, remove it from the Battlefield.  
Once found, the Entrance is carried as Intel by the Unit that found it.  

A Unit may not perform this Action while Adjacent to any enemy Units, or if the Search Marker is Adjacent to any enemy Units.
missions.victory:
- The Relict Wardens win if they are carrying the Entrance Intel at the end of Turn 4. **Proceed to Mission 2A**
- The Interdictors win in all other cases. **Proceed to Mission 2B**

missions.title: The Grim Harvest
missions.description: With access secured, the Wardens begin their macabre work. Corpse tokens become a tug-of-war as Wardens drag specimens toward their labs while Interdictors fight to consign them to burn pits.
missions.setup: Place 2 Corpse Tokens in the center 2 Squares of the Central Tile. Designate the Northern battlefield edge as the **Lab Edge** (Relict Wardens) and the Southern battlefield edge as the **Burn Pit Edge** (Interdictors).
missions.deployment:
- Relict Wardens deploy from the Northern battlefield edge before Turn 1.
- Interdictors deploy from the Southern battlefield edge before Turn 1.
missions.special:
**Mission Action: Harvest (2ACT)**  
A Relict Warden Unit Adjacent to a Corpse Token may spend 2ACT to move that Token 2 Squares toward the Lab Edge.  
A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemy Units.

**Mission Action: Purge (2ACT)**  
An Interdictor Unit Adjacent to a Corpse Token may spend 2ACT to move that Token 2 Squares toward the Burn Pit Edge.  
A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemy Units.

Corpse Tokens cannot be carried or destroyed; they remain on the board and may be contested by both sides.
missions.victory:
- The Relict Wardens win immediately when 2 Corpse Tokens exit the battlefield via the Lab Edge. **Proceed to Mission 3A**
- The Interdictors win immediately when 2 Corpse Tokens exit via the Burn Pit Edge. **Proceed to Mission 3B**
- If neither condition is met by the end of Turn 4, the side with the greater total Squares of progress toward their edge wins; if tied, play 1 extra Turn to determine the winner.

missions.title: The Power Nodes
missions.description: The Interdictors stall the sabotage, forcing the Wardens to try another route. The Wardens push to reactivate dormant pylons by powering their ancient nodes, while the Interdictors rush to disable them.
missions.setup: Place 3 Power Node Markers: one in the center of the West, Center, and East tiles.
missions.deployment:
- Relict Wardens deploy within 2 Squares of any Node before Turn 1.
- Interdictors deploy from the Southern battlefield edge before Turn 1.
missions.special:
**Mission Action: Reactivate Node (2ACT)**  
A Relict Warden Unit Adjacent to a Node may spend 2ACT to activate it. Place an Active marker.  
A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemy Units.

**Mission Action: Overload Node (2ACT)**  
An Interdictor Unit Adjacent to an Active Node may spend 2ACT to disable it. Remove the Active marker.  
A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemy Units.
missions.victory:
- The Relict Wardens win if at least 2 Nodes are Active at the end of Turn 4. **Proceed to Mission 3A**
- The Interdictors win in all other cases. **Proceed to Mission 3B**

missions.title: World-Breaker Awakens
missions.description: The pylons begin to sing. Power builds toward a catastrophic discharge while the Interdictors fight to drag the meter back from the brink.
missions.setup: Place 1 Central Pylon Marker in the center of the Central Tile. Create an off-board **Power Track** starting at 1.
missions.deployment:
- Relict Wardens deploy within 2 Squares of the Pylon before Turn 1.
- Interdictors deploy from the Southern battlefield edge before Turn 1.
missions.special:
**Mission Action: Atune (2ACT)**  
Once per Turn, a Relict Warden Unit Adjacent to the Pylon may spend 2ACT to increase the Power Track by 1 (max 6).  
A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemy Units.

**Mission Action: Detune (2ACT)**  
Once per Turn, an Interdictor Unit Adjacent to the Pylon may spend 2ACT to decrease the Power Track by 1 (min 1).  
A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemy Units.
missions.victory:
- The Relict Wardens win if the Power Track is 4 or higher at the end of Turn 4.
- The Interdictors win if the Power Track is 2 or lower at the end of Turn 4.
- If the Power Track is exactly 3, play 1 extra Turn; whichever side shifts it further in their favor wins.

missions.title: Collapse the Subfoundations
missions.description: The Interdictors seize control of the subfoundations and collapse the ruins above the pylons. The Wardens hurl themselves into the breach, knowing their chance to awaken ancient power is slipping away.
missions.setup: Place 3 Collapse Points: one in the center of the West, Center, and East tiles.
missions.deployment:
- Interdictors deploy within 2 Squares of any Collapse Point before Turn 1.
- Relict Wardens deploy from the Northern battlefield edge before Turn 1.
missions.special:
**Mission Action: Demolish (2ACT)**  
An Interdictor Unit Adjacent to a Collapse Point may spend 2ACT to collapse it. Remove the marker from play.  
A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemy Units.

**Mission Action: Stabilize (2ACT)**  
A Relict Warden Unit Adjacent to a Collapse Point may spend 2ACT to cancel its demolition. Replace the marker if removed this Turn.  
A Unit may not perform this Action if it is Adjacent to any enemy Units.
missions.victory:
- The Interdictors win if at least 2 Collapse Points are demolished by the end of Turn 4.
- The Relict Wardens win in all other cases.
